core_concept: A high-end tactical command center relying on deep space blacks, high-contrast functional accents, and crystal clear glassmorphism over a dark global map. Avoids generic SaaS looks, aiming for military-grade precision and situational awareness.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Command Center. Sharp, legible, high contrast.

layout.strategy: Absolute positioning over a full-screen map. Elements float as glass layers (z-10) above the base map (z-0).
layout.map_layer: Full-screen fixed layout (h-screen w-screen). Leaflet TileLayer: 'https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png'
layout.header: Floating at the top, spans almost full width with side margins. Contains logo and live stats. Glassmorphism styling.
layout.sidebar_feed: Floating on the right side. Fixed width, scrollable inner list. Uses grid-cols-1 with tight gap-4. Displays active alerts.
layout.bottom_bar: Floating at the bottom. Contains the Historical Timeline Slider and risk heatmap toggles. Spans wide but leaves edge gaps.
layout.spacing: Generous padding inside glass panels (p-6). Margins around floating panels (m-4 or m-6) to let map bleed through.

map.style: Dark mode map tiles without labels if possible, to let data shine. Active alert markers must use custom HTML markers with pulsing CSS.

components.glass_panel: div class: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl

alert_card.base: Relative flex items-start p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer
alert_card.indicator: Absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1 rounded-l-xl opacity-80

timeline_slider.base: Use Shadcn Slider, override track to bg-white/20, override thumb to pure white with brand-colored glow depending on context.

icons.usage: Use with 1.5 stroke width. Color them purely based on data context (alert colors) or text-secondary.

marker_pulse.css: @keyframes pulse-ring { 0% { transform: scale(0.8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(var(--alert-rgb), 0.7); } 70% { transform: scale(1.2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 15px rgba(var(--alert-rgb), 0); } 100% { transform: scale(0.8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(var(--alert-rgb), 0); } }

animations.feed_entrance: Staggered fade-in from the right (Framer Motion: x: 20, opacity: 0 -> x: 0, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.1s)
animations.interactions: Hover states on cards: slight translate-y-[-2px] and border-white/20 transition.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Install react-leaflet, leaflet, lucide-react, framer-motion, @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans, @fontsource/jetbrains-mono.
CSS SETUP: Add custom pulse animation to global CSS or Tailwind config. Extend colors in tailwind.config.js for 'alert-heatwave' (red), 'alert-flood' (blue), etc.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI for dropdowns, sliders, and toggles, but heavily override their default Vercel look with the glassmorphism parameters defined above.
MAP IMPLEMENTATION: Use CartoDB Dark Matter tiles (https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png). Ensure the map is z-0 and panels are absolute z-10.
DATA RENDERING: Markers must use Leaflet DivIcon to inject HTML/CSS for the glowing pulse animation. Map color variables to the markers based on severity.
TESTING: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='timeline-slider', data-testid='filter-disease').
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast inside glass panels meets APCA standards. Use text-shadow if map elements interfere with readability.
